nodes.label: Renderer And Sidecar Latency Boundary
nodes.rationale: This is the primary latency boundary, so synchronous work can freeze WebKit and network-heavy requests must remain asynchronous and out-of-order safe.

nodes.label: Canonical Current Song And Source
nodes.rationale: The canonical current song and source must be normalized after every successful URL fallback so queue and playback stores do not diverge.

nodes.label: Download And Playback Source Consistency
nodes.rationale: Downloads must resolve the same effective source used by playback, and quality failure must not be confused with a source mismatch.

nodes.label: Runtime And Cost Flow
nodes.rationale: The full process tree must be measured because the shell, WebView, Rust audio layer, and Node sidecar all contribute to memory.

nodes.label: Documentation And Graph Synchronization Contract
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: Index, Top Graph, handoff, graph, and generated report must remain synchronized in the same work session.

nodes.label: Graph Artifact Ownership Policy
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: The human index, machine graph, curated Top Graph, and generated audit report have distinct ownership roles.

nodes.label: Mandatory Index Maintenance
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: A code edit is incomplete while the graph and index still describe the old system.

nodes.label: Required AI Task Routing
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: Agents should route tasks through the curated index and Top Graph before scanning source files.

nodes.label: Known Graph Health Note
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: Generated and minified sources can create duplicate endpoint, self-loop, and dangling-edge warnings, so the curated Top Graph remains the safer architecture map.

nodes.label: Graphify Indexing Scope
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: Code uses deterministic AST extraction, project knowledge documents use semantic extraction, and static assets remain path-level references.

nodes.label: Read Index Before Source Files
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: The index is the fast search doorway for agents and should be read before opening source files.

nodes.label: Graph Update Failure Recovery
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: A failed update must not replace a valid graph with an empty or partial extraction.

nodes.label: Graph Maintenance Invariants
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: The index, Top Graph, handoff, graph, and generated outputs must stay synchronized, while the Electron reference remains read-only.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Requirement
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: Changed documents that affect meaning must be processed by a semantic extraction agent because a hand-edited graph without an extraction record is invalid.

nodes.label: Top Graph Maintenance Rule
nodes.community_name: Ceru Music Tauri AI Search Index
nodes.rationale: After any architecture change, the Top Graph and the maintenance log in AI_INDEX must be updated.

nodes.label: Desktop Lyric Height And Reveal Lifecycle
nodes.norm_label: desktop lyric height and reveal lifecycle

nodes.label: Active And Read-Only Project Boundary
nodes.rationale: The Tauri migration is active while the Electron project remains a read-only behavioral reference.

nodes.label: Desktop Lyric Logical Pixel Geometry
nodes.rationale: Logical pixels match Electron getBounds and setBounds behavior and prevent Retina scaling, drag, resize drift, and snap-back.

nodes.label: Mandatory Electron Parity
nodes.rationale: Electron behavior is the source of truth; Tauri may adapt only the shell, IPC, window, WebView, or platform boundary.

nodes.label: Full Process Tree Memory Measurement
nodes.rationale: Tauri shell savings alone are insufficient because the Node compatibility sidecar carries independent memory cost.

nodes.label: Handoff Project Boundary
nodes.rationale: Development continues only in the Tauri project while the completed Electron project remains an intact read-only reference.

nodes.label: Unwanted Electron Instance Guard
nodes.rationale: Application-name lookup resolved to the packaged Electron app, launched duplicate release instances, and showed the wrong UI.
